title: Hardcoded absolute path and path-separator census
question_or_target: Which source files contain a hardcoded absolute path, a drive letter, a home directory, or a hardcoded path separator that would break on another platform or another user profile?
evidence_requirement_verbatim: Probe 1: a literal-string scan for drive letters, /home/, /Users/, and backslash separators inside path contexts. Probe 2: an AST-aware pass that distinguishes a path literal from a regex or a documentation string, since a backslash in a regex is not a path separator.
named_probe_requirements_verbatim: Probe 1: a literal-string scan for drive letters, /home/, /Users/, and backslash separators inside path contexts.
Probe 2: an AST-aware pass that distinguishes a path literal from a regex or a documentation string, since a backslash in a regex is not a path separator.
tests_required: use-vs-mention control: a regex containing a backslash and a docstring containing C: must NOT be flagged, while an open() on the same literal must be
